definitions.explanation: The part of a chair, sofa, or seat designed to support the arm. Found on office chairs, airplane seats, theater seats, and sofas.

examples.japanese: {椅子|いす}の{肘掛|ひじか}けに{腕|うで}を{乗|の}せた。
examples.english: I rested my arm on the armrest of the chair.

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}の{肘掛|ひじか}けを{隣|となり}の{人|ひと}と{取|と}り{合|あ}った。
examples.english: I fought over the armrest with the person sitting next to me on the plane.

examples.japanese: この{肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす}は{座|すわ}り{心地|ごこち}がよくて{長時間|ちょうじかん}の{作業|さぎょう}でも{疲|つか}れにくい。
examples.english: This armchair is comfortable and doesn't tire you out even during long work sessions.

notes:
USAGE:
Also used in the compound {肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす} (armchair). A practical vocabulary word that comes up when shopping for furniture, discussing office equipment, or talking about seats on planes and trains.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす} (armchair)
- {肘掛|ひじか}けの{高|たか}さ (armrest height)
- {肘掛|ひじか}けを{上|あ}げる / {下|さ}げる (to raise / lower the armrest)
